title: Rav Huna son of Rav Pinchas
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Moed Katan 15b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.15b.14), speaking in Rav Yosef’s name; but Hyman reports Rav Acha as the reading in Dikdukei Soferim, and likewise [there at 15a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.15a.13) the statement is attributed to Rav Acha bar Pinchas.[^1]

notes.text: The first passage names Rav Huna son of Rav Pinchas, and the second names Rav Acha bar Pinchas. Each speaks in Rav Yosef’s name, in a different application of a similar answer. Rav Acha in the first passage is Hyman’s report from Dikdukei Soferim.
